name: V14: The AI Workflow Console That Keeps You in the Flow
blurb: Voice & Physical Control for Claude, Codex, and Other AI Coding Agents | Color Display | Bluetooth Connection | Local Paraformer
story_text:
## AI Coding Is Fast. Managing AI Isn’t.
AI coding assistants can write code, run tasks, fix bugs, and handle repetitive work.
But when you work with multiple agents at the same time, something else happens:
You become the window manager.
Switch to Claude.
Check Codex.
Jump back to your terminal.
Copy a follow-up instruction.
Find the right session.
Click “Approve.”
Switch again.
Every interruption comes at a cost.
The more capable your AI coding team becomes, the more effort it takes to keep track of everything.
Coding with AI shouldn’t mean managing windows.
## Meet MicStick V14
The Handheld Command Center for Your AI Coding Team.
MicStick V14 is a dedicated handheld remote built for developers working with multiple AI agents.
It combines voice input, a built-in display, and physical controls in one compact device. It is designed to help you manage multiple AI coding sessions without constantly leaving your current task.
Think of it as a command baton for your AI coding team.
Instead of constantly reaching for your keyboard and switching between windows, keep the essential controls in your hand.
Speak to the right agent.
See what’s happening.
Approve what matters.
Stay in control.
MicStick V14 makes your interaction with AI agents more direct, physical, and immediate.
Less window switching. Fewer interruptions. More time building.
## Speak. See. Approve
## 01 — Speak
Voice goes to the chosen session
Hold to speak, release to send. Your voice goes directly into the selected Claude Code or Codex session.
## 02 — See
Multi-Session Status at a Glance
The screen and lights show recording, recognition, pending approvals, and the active session.
You don’t need to keep checking every window just to know whether something needs your attention.
## 03 — Approve
Physical Approval Controls
Confirm, cancel, and switch sessions with dedicated controls. Less keyboard juggling and window switching.
## Status at hand
Reduce the attention cost of repeatedly checking the terminal. The dedicated screen lets you quickly check agent activity and important requests.
Traditional AI coding workflows often look like this:
Find the window → Read the status → Switch back → Type → Wait → Approve → Repeat
MicStick V14 changes the interaction:
Speak → See → Approve → Continue
The goal isn’t to replace your keyboard, monitor, or IDE.
It’s to remove the unnecessary steps between your decision and your AI team.
## Buttons & Scene Controls
Control at Your Fingertips
One-touch control for AI sessions and daily tasks.
## Beyond AI. Everyday Control
AI Sessions + Everyday Tasks. One Device.
MicStick V14 isn’t just for AI sessions. Assign keys to everyday actions—adjust volume, switch between videos, control playback, and more.
One compact device for your AI workflow and your daily setup.
## Intelligent Power Management
MicStick V14 automatically reduces power consumption based on its power source, connection status, and activity.
After a short period of inactivity, it simply dims the display or turns the screen off. After an extended period on standby, it powers down completely—preserving battery life and keeping it ready for your next command.
## Hot-Swappable Freedom
Hot-swappable buttons let you replace and reconfigure your controls yourself.
## Compact. Portable. Always Ready
Small enough to keep beside you
Fits on your desk, in your bag, or in your pocket. Ready whenever your AI needs you.

## About MicStick V14
MicStick V14 was born from our own frustration. Running Claude, Codex, and other AI agents in parallel meant constantly switching windows, losing focus, and missing approval prompts. We built the first prototype for ourselves — and quickly realized that any developer juggling multiple agents would need it too.
Our backgrounds span embedded systems, PCB design, wireless firmware, human-machine interface hardware, and manufacturing. We’ve shipped consumer electronics before, and we know the difference between a cool demo and a product that can actually be manufactured, tested, and delivered.
We're excited to build it with you.
risks: We believe backers deserve honesty, not optimism. We’ve completed the V14 design package — CAD, PCB, Gerber, BOM, and factory-test firmware. But moving from validation to mass production is never a straight line. Key risks remain: - DFM, tooling, and pilot runs may reveal issues needing revisions. - Component lead times and allocation can shift. - Firmware, AI, and app performance need real-world tuning; results vary by accent and environment. - Mass production yield and quality control must be proven. - Logistics, customs, and tariffs may cause delays. We can’t promise zero delays. We can promise transparent updates and no silence. Thank you for your trust.

faq.a: The companion software runs on macOS and Windows.

MicStick is designed to work with Claude, Codex, and other agent-based coding tools that expose session-level control. Additional agent integrations will be added through firmware and software updates after launch.

MicStick is a handheld session console for multi-agent coding. It lets you select a Claude or Codex session, speak a complete instruction, see the agent's status, and physically approve or reject actions — without switching windows on your Mac.
